technical_quality: Adequate penetration (thoracic spine faintly visible through the heart) with minimal rotation; good inspiration (long lung fields). Scapulae partly project over the lateral lung fields. The lower thorax is cropped so both costophrenic angles are only partially included. An L marker is present at image right, confirming conventional orientation.

devices.type: external round radiopaque object (button/lead marker), approx 1.5 cm
devices.location: projected over the left shoulder / lateral left clavicle, just below the L marker
left upper corner of the field (patient's left)

abnormalities.finding: Hyperinflated, hyperlucent lungs with peripheral vascular attenuation and a narrow, vertical (tubular) cardiac silhouette, low-lying hemidiaphragms
Accentuated bronchovascular / interstitial markings in the perihilar and lower zones (partly overlapped by breast shadows)
Prominent aortic knob / convex left upper mediastinal contour
Mildly prominent hila, right slightly more than left, without discrete mass

description_zh: 正面站立胸部X光片，穿透度與吸氣程度足夠，無明顯旋轉，但下胸部略被切除，雙側肋膈角僅部分顯示。雙側肺野呈過度充氣與透亮度增加，周邊血管紋理稀疏，橫膈位置偏低，心影狹長呈垂直管狀，符合肺氣腫／過度充氣之表現；雙側肺門周圍及下肺野支氣管血管紋理增加（部分與乳房陰影重疊）。主動脈弓突出，雙側肺門略顯突出但無明確腫塊，未見明顯實質浸潤、肋膜積液或氣胸。體內無任何管路或裝置，左肩／左鎖骨外側處可見一圓形體外不透光物（鈕扣或標記），骨骼結構無明顯異常。
